cohort: The study included 260 pregnant women for the prevalence study and 200 women (100 cases, 100 controls) from medical records of an obstetrics hospital in Vale do Paranhana, Brazil.
finding: Maternal age over 30 years, diabetes mellitus (DM), and previous cardiovascular comorbidities were identified as significant risk factors for the development of Hypertensive Gestational Syndromes (HGS).
cross-section timing: Data was retrieved from medical records from 2017 to 2022.
